body.displayDescription: Tier-90 Magic power gloves. Dragon Breath empowers Combust for 6 seconds: +25% damage and all remaining hits land on the next normal hit tick. Enchantment of flames raises the damage bonus to 40% after 9 seconds worn.
body.mechanicalImplementation: passiveId: kerapac-combust. Dragon Breath arms a 10-tick cast window and detonates an active Combust's remaining scheduled hits on their next normal hit tick. The flames account unlock changes the multiplier from 1.25 to 1.40 from tick 15 onward.

effects: Base ability damage gains 25% of equipment Total Armour, doubled with a defender and tripled with a shield.
Base health regeneration gains 2.5% of maximum life points with the same multipliers.
body.name: Teragard's Aegis

assumptions: Teragard's Aegis uses equipment Total Armour only (the Loadout Hero armour sum). Defence level, Fortitude, prayer or curse block levels, and blockArmourRating do not change the share.
The shield and defender shares are the card's flat 25/50/75%, so the percentage resolves before the single rounding.
Only a genuinely wielded off-hand qualifies; a stored shield or defender under a two-handed weapon does not, and a shield effect granted by an ability is not a wielded shield.
The equipment-armour share is added to direct base ability damage before the ability's own damage band, but is excluded from the ability-damage basis used by poison.

reason: Record the confirmed poison boundary for Teragard's Aegis.

effects: Your base ability damage is increased by 30%.

body.name: Higher Power

assumptions: The 30% increase is applied to resolved base ability damage before ability damage bands and final hit modifiers.
The increased ability-damage basis applies to poison damage, including Tearing Thorns' Grasp of Guthix poison component.
League-owned ability metadata removes the base ultimate abilities and every replacement or upgraded variant from selection, persisted bars, solver pools, Revolution and cast validation.
